note: Each case: verify `bundle` with the named keys (see `keys`) and `attestation` (the attestation bundle, the release digest, and the options). The gateway key is trusted only through the attestation. `expected.failing` lists the check names that must fail. The Confidential Space cases use a TEST chain, never a genuine Google token; the simulated cases use the published simulated key.

cases.name: attested-simulated-allowed
cases.description: A gateway with a simulated attestation; the verifier is given the attestation, the release digest the simulation claims, and the test flag. Every check passes, and attested build says SIMULATED.

cases.name: attested-simulated-refused
cases.description: The same receipt without the test flag: simulated evidence never passes attested build.

cases.name: attested-simulated-other-release
cases.description: The same receipt checked against another release digest.

cases.name: attested-key-outside
cases.description: The receipt re-signed by a key outside the attestation, which the verifier also trusts: the receipt is not signed by the attested key.

failing: receipt signed by the attested key

cases.name: attested-evidence-tampered
cases.description: The attestation's evidence edited to claim another image, without the attested key's signature: the statement signature fails and the key is not trusted.

cases.name: attested-gcp-test-chain
cases.description: A Confidential Space token in the documented shape, signed by a TEST chain whose root the verifier pins (gcpRoots). Every check passes.

cases.name: attested-gcp-default-root
cases.description: The same token with only Google's root pinned (the default): the TEST chain does not end there.

cases.name: attested-gcp-other-release
cases.description: The same token checked against another release digest.
